history.reason: Reads 1 minute per tick from persisted state (tail); a cold start reads 10 minutes (recent). Five numbers of state; a cold start needs about 10 points (10 minutes) to settle.

extended:
groups:
  - name: anomalies/1m
    interval: 1m
    rules:
      - alert: LatencyAnomaly
        expr: sum by (service) (rate(latency_ms_sum[5m]))
        annotations:
          summary: "{{ $labels.service }} latency"
        anomaly:
          detector: ewma
          params:
            minDeviation: 0
            direction: both
            minSpread: 0
            halfLifePoints: 5
            k: 4
            minPoints: 5
            clip: true
            acceptAfter: 5
            staleAfterMs: 1.7976931348623157e+308
          given:
            - halfLifePoints
            - k
            - minPoints
          severity: ticket
          max_series: 100
          unit: ms
